'''Pedisic''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] specialist in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] military during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Around the year [[3643 BBY]], Pedisic and [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] [[Eldon Ax]] were called to the ''[[Paramount]]'' in order to extract information from the memory of a [[Fastbreeder|hex droid]]. It was hoped that the information would lead the Sith to a resource-rich planet. She told Eldon about the coordinates, which led to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sebaddon]]. However Pedisic thought the coordinates of location must be wrong because it led to [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]].
